tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (587)༄༅/ /mgon po a ti sha gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' gdams bla ma rnams mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i cho ga bkra shis grags pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba ba
(587)༄༅/ /mgon po a ti sha gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' gdams bla ma rnams mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i cho ga bkra shis grags pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba ba

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (587)༄༅// mgon po a ti sha gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' gdams bla ma rnams mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i cho ga bkra shis grags pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(588)༄༅// na mo gu ru dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñān pā dā ya// gang la brten na rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi chos// ji snyed bde blag nyid du rdzogs 'gyur ba// dpal ldan bla ma brgyud par bcas rnams la// byang chub bar du sgo gsum gus pas 'dud// bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams// mchod las don che gzhan med par// mdo rgyud kun nas bsngags de'i phyir// mos blos nus dang mtshams par dgod/ /de'ang ji skad du/ skye bo phal pa stong phrag brgya// bram ze gtsang ma gcig dang sbyar// bram ze gtsang ma stong phrag brgya// 'khor los sgyur ba gcig dang sbyar// 'khor los sgyur ba stong phrag brgya// ye shes thob ba gcig dang sbyar// ye shes thob pa stong phrag brgya// dgra bcom pa ni gcig dang sbyar// dgra bcom pa ni stong phrag brgya// dpal ldan bla ma gcig dang sbyar// ces yul gong nas gong du 'phags shing gnyan par gsungs pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra (589)ba chen po'i zhal nas/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba las dge ba'i bshes gnyen la 'das mchod byas pa bsod nams che gsungs/ de'i bsod nams mdor bsdu na drug ste/ spyir sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gyur ba dang*/ khyad par du dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas bsags pa'i ma gus pa byas pa thams cad 'dzad par 'gyur ba dang*/ tshogs myur du rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ tshe rabs nas tshe rabs thams cad du gdul byar 'gyur ba dang*/ khyad par tu skye ba 'di'i 'og rol tu mjal bar 'gyur ba dang*/ 'khor ba las myur du thar bar 'gyur ba'o// de ltar don chen po dang ldan pa'i bla ma mchod pa'i rim pa nyams su bstar ba la gnyis/ sbyor ba sta gon tu bya ba/ dngos gzhi nyams len gyi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ jo bo chen po dga' ldan tu gshegs pa'i dus chen gtsos brgyud pa gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus bzang por/

thog mtha' kun tu ma gyur sems can thams cad byang chub chen po'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i slad du bla ma sangs rgyas mchod pa'i las (590)btson par bgyi ba'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i kun slong dang ma bral bas gnas khang phyag dar bya/ sbos chus bran bzang shing gis bdug la shin tu gtsang mar byas pa'i gung du thub pa'i sku brnyan/ sher phyin glegs bam/ bka' gdams mchod rten gtsor gyur sku gsung thugs rten gang 'byor spyi dang khyad par bka' gdams bla ma brgyud pa'i sku gzugs bris 'bur gang 'byor bkram/ stegs gtsang mar rin po che'i maṇḍal la 'bru'i tshom bu gtso 'khor lnga bkod pa bzhag /mtha' bskor du rin po che sogs snod gang 'byor shin tu gtsang la ya yo med par bkod legs su byas par chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ gzhan yang 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun/ bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs mchod pa'i yo byad ji tsam 'byor ba nus pa ma bsris pa bsham/ mchod pa'i maṇḍal/ rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang 'du bya/ 'byor na bla bre 'phan gdugs sogs rgyan gyi bye brag rnams kyis kyang brgyan par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid khrus bya zhing spos kyis bsang*/ rten la phyogs pas bde bar 'khod de skyabs sems ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis bla ma mchod pa'i rim pa la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /zhes byang chub sems yid la bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig

/nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /ces sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i tshad med pa bzhi yun ring du bsgom/ de nas rang gi mos pa'i stobs kyis ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin/ bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang (591) de ltar du byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang byin rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthu dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi yon tan dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyang ba'i mthu dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi mos pa'i mthu las gnas 'dir sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rgyan dang bkod pa dang*/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur pa'i dbus su thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub cing rgya 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i tshad dang mnyam pa/ khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gnas rnam par thar pa'i sgo bsum gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa/ phyi nang kun tu gdan rin po che seng ge'i khri padma dang nyi zlas brgyan pa du ma dang lha dang mi'i rdzas dam pa bde ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa dang ldan pa'i mchod pa'i sprin bkod pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa las kyang mngon par mtho bas brgyan pa dang ldan par gyur cig /na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra sā ra pra mardha ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ārha te/ ma buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bidya badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta maṇḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum dang*/

slar yang / dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de de (592)bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod/ de nas 'dun pa rtse gcig pas sbos btul zhing snyan pa'i gdangs dang bcas pas/ phyogs dus kun khyab skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs te// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol// rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje tshad med 'gro la phyogs bcur gzigs// rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rgyas mdzad pa// dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs shig /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ces gsol ba btab pas steng phyogs dga' ldan gyi gnas sogs dag pa'i zhing so so nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal ldan mar me mdzad bzang po la bka' gdams brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang gi dge 'dun/ chos skyong srung ma ye shes pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas bskor ba sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa ltar byon nas so so'i gdan la dgyes bzhin tu bzhugs par bsams la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /ces byon legs bya de nas khrus gsol ba'i thog mar snyan brnan pa ni/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang*/

(593)de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /lus gsol ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la// nyon mongs sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can sgo gsum sgrib sbyang phyir// gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus gsol lo/ /sku phyi ba ni/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /de nas gos 'bul ba ni/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyong phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes brjod pas tshogs (594) kyi zhing du brtan par bzhugs par mos/ de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra ba chen po'i bzhed pa ltar rjes su dran pa drug gi sgo nas sgom zhing yid la bya ste/

dang po sku'i rnam pa rjes su dran pa ni/ gzhal med khang mchog de yi dbus kyi char// mi 'jigs seng ges btegs pa'i rin chen khrir// ma chags padma zla ba'i gdan steng du// rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid mchog /'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan a ti sha*/mnyam med jo bo mar me mdzad bzang po// dkar gsal zhi 'dzum phyag gnyis chos 'chad tshul// dbu la paṇa zhu sku la ngur smrig gi chos gos gsum gsol zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs// bag dro lhun chags ye shes gzi byin 'bar// paṇa chen sa snying nag tsho lo tsā sogs// 'phags bod mkhas grub thugs sras rnams kyis bskor// dbu gtsug dbus su rdo rje 'chang chen la// nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor// g.yas phyogs 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras la// zab mo lta ba brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor// g.yon phyogs 'phags pa thogs med sku mched la// rgya chen spyod rgyud bla mas bskor te bzhugs// gtso bo'i g.yas su 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung*// dge bsnyen chas ldan sa gnon sems skyil bzhugs// sku mched gsum dang glang shar rnam gnyis sogs// dngos slob yang slob sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor// g.yon tu rngog ston legs pa'i shes rab mchog /rab byung chas ldan paṇa zhu rna ring gsol// phyag gnyis chos 'chad zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs// blo ldan shes rab thu bo'i sras bzhi sogs// brgyud 'dzin mkhas dbang ngur smrig 'dzin pas bskor// rgyab tu khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung dang*// khams pa sku mched lnga la sogs pa bzhugs// mdun tu 'jam (595)dpal dbyangs dngos blo bzang grags// paṇa zhu gser mdog chos gos rnam gsum gsol// chos 'khor phyag rgya zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs// gtsang pa bdun brgyud dge 'dun grub la sogs// bstan 'dzin skyes chen bgrang las 'das pas bskor// steng 'og phyogs mtshams mtha' bskor thams cad du// rgya bod mkhas grub yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas// mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa lta bur bzhugs// zung 'jug ye shes dang las ma g.yos bzhin// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la rtag tu gzigs// thams cad bde nas bde bar 'dren pa yi// rmad byung phrin las lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad// 'brel tshad don ldan nyid du lam mer bzhugs/

/zhes brjod cing sku'i rnam pa gsal btab la dang mos bskyed pa phyi ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ gnyis pa yon tan rjes su dran pa ni/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che// sangs rgyas rnams dang chos skur dbyer ba med// dam chos gsungs shing gzhan don mdzad pa yang*// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dbyer med pa'i// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan bsam yas mnga'// gnas skabs dang por bstan la zhugs nas bzung*// bslab gsum sgrub la ltems rkyang mi mnga' bas// lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dpag med brnyes// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun la bskal pa'i bar// mchod sprin rgya mtshos rtag tu mchod pa bas// bla ma'i ba spu'i khung bur 'bru mar gyi// thigs pa gcig gsol bsod nams khyad par 'phags// de lta'i yon tan bsam mi khyab pa'o/ /zhes bsam/ gsum pa rnam thar rjes su dran pa ni/ zab mo lta brgyud rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud// (596)nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa kun 'dus shing*// kun las khyad 'phags lha gcig jo bo rje// skyes bu chen po rnams kyi chos lugs dang*// shing rta chen po thun mong min pa'i srol// 'phags pa nyid nas 'phags pa nyid brgyud cing*// thun mong spyod pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa// bka' gdams rnam thar gtsang ma 'dzin pa can// shin tu ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'o/ /zhes bsam/ bzhi pa phrin las rjes su dran pa ni/ /dus ngan sems can bdag cag la sogs pa// las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba dang*// dam chos thos pa'i skal pa dang bral zhing*// nyon mongs tshan che gnyen po stobs chung bas// dge sems gcig tsam skye bar dka' ba la// sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon pa ji lta bar// rgyud tshod dpag pa'i gdams ngag 'bogs pa dang*// dbang por 'tshams pa'i dam chos bdud rtsi stsal// blo dang mthun pa'i khrid rim bstan pa yis// yang dag lam la dkri ba'i phrin las ni// sangs rgyas las kyang phul du gyur pa'o/

/zhes bsam/ lnga pa byin rlabs rjes su dran pa ni/ /gang gi thugs rje'i gzigs pa cha shas tsam// gtad pa'i mthus kyang blo ngan bdag cag gi rgyud la gtong ba'i sems skyes 'tshal pa 'gog /gnod bzod dge la brtson dang zhi lhag sogs// bsam dang sbyor ba byang chub sems dpa' yi// spyod pa pha rol phyin drug sgrub pa la// mngon tu phyogs par mdzad pa'i byin rlabs can/ /ces bsam/ drug pa bka' drin rjes su dran pa ni/ /de yi thugs rje'i mthu dpal la brten nas// yon tan 'byung gnas tshul khrims rin po ches// bdag rgyud legs brgyan dam chos bsam du btub// dkar po'i chos rnams yar zla bzhin tu 'phel// 'jig rten dang ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i// dpal yon phun sum (597)tshogs la dbang 'byor mdzad// de 'dra'i bka' drin mnyam pa med pa'o/

/zhes pa rnams ni rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gtso bo dbyer med la dmigs shing bsgoms la mos gus bskyed/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la'ang brgyud nas bka' drin che ba sogs bsgom pa'o// de nas yan lag bdun gyi tshogs bsags pa la/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi rten dngos su bzhugs pa dang yid kyis bsgoms de rnams kyi zhabs padma dang bcas pa la rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug lhan lhan gtugs par sems shing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni// dran pa tsam gyis sel mdzad cing*// bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa'i// bla ma'i zhabs kyi padmor 'dud// gang gis ma rig mun pa'i tshogs// smag tu gyur pa sel mdzad pa// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis 'khor pa'i sdug bsngal gyi// tsha gdung ma lus sel mdzad pa// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis 'dod chags la sogs pa'i// nyon mongs nad rnams sel mdzad pa// sman pa'i rgyal po lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis zag med bde chen gyis// grong khyer mchog tu skyel mdzad pa'i// rta mchog rin chen lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis skye rga na 'chi yi// chu bo che las sgrol mdzad pa// mnyan pa'i rgyal po lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis 'gro ba'i dgos 'dod dag /yid bzhin rdzogs par 'byung 'gyur ba// nor bu rin chen lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis chos rnams thams cad kun// 'du 'bral med par khyab gyur pa// nam mkha' (598)lta bu'i thugs mnga' ba'i// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun ste// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon gnas te// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// zab mo lta ba'i brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo// rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo// nyams len byin rlabs brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan a ti sha la phyag 'tshal lo// byams pa nas brgyud byin rlabs rin po che// jo bo yab sras yon tan rin po che// sku mched bka' brgyud dam pa rin po che// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes dang*/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /zhes pa nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// ces pa'i bar brjod cing gus pa dang gus pa chen po'i sgo nas phyag thub tshad gcig 'tshal te/ de yang sangs rgyas sgom pa'i zhal nas/ thal mo thugs ka dang smin mtshams su sbyor ba kun la gus pa zer ba yin/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu sbyar ba kun la gus pa chen po zer ba yin/ ces sogs gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ spyan snga rin po ches/ kun bzang spyod lag gsungs pa'i// mchod pa rnam pa bdun dag kyang*/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i dang po sku lta ba'i mchod pa ni/ langs pa la 'phro de kar/ 'di ltar bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ (599)sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhal// mngon sum mjal dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten// 'di rnams mjal la khyad par cung zad med// rten mchog 'di dag kho na bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems byin rlabs stobs nyid las// byon pa'i sprul sku dngos yin bdag nyid kyis// dbang po'i mngon sum 'phags pa'i tshogs 'di snyed// mngon tu gyur pa'i skye ba grangs med kyang*// da res rnyed pa mchog ni legs par rnyed/ /ces brjod cing snying nas yid ches pa'i dad pas rten dngos su bsham pa la ce re ba zhig bltas pas sdig sgrib dpag tu med pa 'dzad par gsungs/ gnyis pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bstod pa dang*/ 'brom rin po ches mdzad pa'i jo bo'i bstod pa/ phun sum tshogs pa bhaṅga la yi yul/ /ces sogs bka' gdams gsar rnying gi bla ma rnams kyi bstod pa gang lcogs bya/ mi shes shing mi lcogs na jo bo'i bstod pa tsam dang spyi bsdus su/ nyes pa'i skyon kun rab spangs shing*// legs pa'i yon tan kun ldan pas// phan bde dpal 'byor kun 'byung ba'i// dpal ldan bla ma khyed la bstod// gdul bya smin cing grol ba'i phyir// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// 'dren pa'i tshul du rnam 'phrul ba'i// dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal// khyed sku sha dang rus bral yang*// ye shes gzugs su snang ba'i sku// dad pa'i mig rkyen mchog gyur pa// sku yi dbang phyug khyed la bstod// brjod 'dod rtsol ba mi mnga' yang*// yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs kyis// zab cing rgya che'i don ston pa// gsung gi dbang phyug khyed la bstod// shes dang shes bya'i spros bral yang*// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thugs// snying rje gzungs spobs du ma'i gter// thugs kyi dbang phyug khyed la bstod// yon tan cha tsam 'gro kun gyis// (600)bskal par brjod kyang mi zad pa'i// spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs// yon tan dbang phyug khyed la bstod// mthong thos dran pas don ldan na// bsten na grol ba ci smos pa// lhun grub rgyun chad mi mnga' ba'i// phrin las dbang phyug khyed la bstod// 'khor 'das phun tshogs ji snyed kun// dam pa'i chos la byung ba ste// de yang khyed las byung gyur pa// phan bde'i 'byung gnas khyed la bstod// ji ltar ji snyed kun mkhyen gyis// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib spangs pas// rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog gyur pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyed la bstod// khyed thugs rtogs pa'i dam chos te// gsung gi rgyu mthun lung gi chos// rnam grol 'jug ngogs mchog gyur pa// dam chos rin chen khyed la bstod// rang bzhin 'od gsal mngon gyur cing*// gnyis 'dzin rtog pa las grol bas// bsod nams zhing rab mchog gyur pa// tshogs mchog gtso bo khyed la bstod// 'dod pa'i 'ching ba kun spangs nas// dri med bslab gsum brtul zhugs can// sdom brtson ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gtso// shākya'i sras mchog khyed la bstod// stong nyid snying rje'i sems mchog gis// gcig tu gzhan phan brtson pa can// rgyal sras sems dpa' rnams kyi yab// brtse ldan dpa' bo khyod la bstod// smin grol lam la rab sbyangs pas// rim gnyis rnal 'byor dbang phyug can// rig pa 'dzin pa kun gyi rje// rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khyod la bstod/

/ces pa tsam gyis bstod/ de nas bstan pa 'di'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa yin pas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub ba'i thang sku'am lugs ma zhig gi smin mtshams nas 'od zer nyi ma'i zer 'dra ba dkar shar shar 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog /las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad (601) dag nas sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku bkra spung nge gyur par bsam/ de rnams sor bzhag /'od zer tshur 'dus pas bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams su thim par bsams la sangs rgyas la yon tan 'di lta bu mnga' ba yin snyam pa'i dad pa dang gus pas yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes sogs 'don cing yon tan re re bzhin yid la bya/ de bzhin du chos dang dge 'dun rjes su dran pa bya ste dge bshes sangs rgyas sgom pa'i bzhed pa'o// gsum pa rdzas dngos su bsham pa'i mchod pa ni thog mar mchod pa'i maṇḍal phyis shing dri bzang gi chus chag chag gdab/ tshom bu so bdun ma sogs spyi ltar bkod cing*/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyis gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug mu khyud kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ shar du lus dang lus 'phags/ lhor rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ nub tu g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ byang du sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma mos pa'i lo tog /'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/

bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi grangs las 'das pa mngon par bkod de rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong (602)srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ces dang*/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing sogs tshigs bcad rgyas bsdus gang shes kyis 'bul/ de nas dngos su bshams pas rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam las rnam par 'phrul pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod par bsam la/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ /des 'gres spos te/ zhabs bsil= me tog= bdug spos= snang gsal= dri mchog= zhal zas= sil snyan bar du sbyar nas mchod pa'i srin gyi gzungs sngags brjod la rol mo bya/ bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa ni/ rgyas bar spro na/ 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun/ bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs 'bral ba'i tshigs bcad yongs su grags pa rnams brjod/ mdor bsdu na/ mdzes sdug gzugs dang snyan brjid rol mo'i sgra// dri zhim dang ldang bcud ldan ro brgya'i zas// 'jam mnyen reg bya'i bye brag dpag med pa// nam mkha' gang ba blo yis rab sprul te// bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams kyis bzhes su gsol// gser gyi 'khor lo 'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor// yid 'phrog btsun mo blo ldan khyim gyi bdag

/theg chen glang po cang shes rta yi mchog /nam mkha'= /bla ma= /thugs rje'i= /rin chen gdugs bzang rgyal mtshan dpal be'u// mdangs mdzes padma dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil// bum bzang gser nya 'khor lo bkra shis rtags// nam mkha'= /bla ma= /thugs rje'i= /kun tu dge legs byed pa'i rdzas kyi mchog /me long li khri dūrba bilba'i 'bras// gi waṃ dung dang zho mchog yungs (603)kar rnams// nam mkha'= /bla ma= /thugs rje'i= /dga' ba'i tshal dang bkod legs khang pa bzang*// mal stan lha yi gos mchog sbrul gyi pags// ral gri mchil lh+wam nye ba'i rin chen bdun// nam mkha'= /bla ma= /thugs rje'i= /rin chen ri bo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing*// 'dod 'jo'i ba mo ma rmos lo tog 'bru// bdud rtsi'i btung ba ro brgya'i zhal zas sogs// nam mkha'= /bla ma= /thugs rje'i= de nas rin chen bdar bu nam mkha' bdar la/ gser g.yu dngul dang bye ru shel la sogs// rin chen sna lnga'i phye ma char bzhin tu// mchod 'os rnams kyi sku la babs pa yang*// nam mkha'= /bla ma= /thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams kyis bzhes su gsol/ ces dang*/ me tog dam pa sogs nas/ rgyal ba kun la rab tu mchod par bgyi/ /bar brjod/ lnga pa bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa dang*/ drug pa lus 'bul ba'i mchod pa ni/ spyod 'jug mchod pa'i le'u las 'byung ba/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ sogs nas/ /nges pa kun tu 'byung gyur cig /bar brjod/ bdun pa sgrub pa'i mchod pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed bya ba ste// 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ /bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun chen po rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/lan gsum/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed pa'i don yid la dran bzhin tu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems (604)dpa'i thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam gyi sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyis skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin can gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma bsgral ba rnams sgrol par bgyi'o// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyung pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum dang*/ slar yang skyabs sems sgrags ma'i tshul du/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gang mang brjod/ gsum pa bshags pa ni/ sdig pa sbyong thabs shin tu mang ba'i nang jo bo rje lha gcig byang chub ltung bshags la bsngags pa che bar gsungs pa ltar ltung bshags tshar gcig nas gsum sogs brjod/ dge bshes glang lung pas spyi bshags gal che bar gsungs pas byang chub sems dang 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa yid la byas te/

bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i (605)sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bcu bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa las 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya las 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig las 'gal pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la ma dad cing ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ pha dang ma la ma dad cing ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma dad cing ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma dad cing ma gus par bgyis pa dang*/ gsung rabs kyi glud zos pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur pa btab pa dang*/ sems can la gnod par bgyis pa la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyud gyur ba'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci bgyis pa thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// mi 'chab bo// mi sbed do// slan chad kyang gcod cing sdom par bgyi'o// mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur la/ ma mthol zhing ma bshags na de ltar mi 'gyur ba lags so/ /zhes lan gsum dang*/ de nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ sogs sho lo ka gcig brjod/ spyod 'jug las 'byung ba/ bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'i// (606)bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin pa// gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams// mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du// thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis// yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// 'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig

/nongs pa lags par gzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po ma lags pas// slan chad bdag ni yongs mi bgyid/ /zhes pa rnams kyis bshags/ bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams dang sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ sems can kun gyi ngan song gi sdug bsngal ngal sos bde ba dang*// sdug bsngal can rnams bder gnas la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nges par thar la yi rang ngo*/ /lnga pa chos 'khor bskul ba ni/ gang rnams phyogs bcu'i sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thums la// chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol/ /drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /mya ngan 'da' ston sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// 'gro 'di ldong bar mi 'god phyir// bskal pa grangs med bzhugs su gsol/ /bdun pa bsngo ba ni/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ de ltar 'di dag kun byas te// dge ba dag gis bsags pa gang*// des ni sems can thams cad kyis// sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /ces bsags sbyangs spel gsum gyi dngos gzhis yan lag bdun pa byas nas dad pa rtse gcig pas gsol ba 'debs pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis mas spyir jo bo rje sogs bka' gdams kyi bla ma rnams kyis gsol 'debs gang (607) shes rgyas par bya/ 'dir mdor bsdus pa ni/ thub dbang byams mgon thogs med sku mched sogs// rgya chen spyod rgyud bla ma mchog rnams dang*// rgyal sras 'jam dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub sogs// zab mo lta ba'i brgyud pa mchog rnams dang*// gsang bdag rnal 'byor ma dpal ti lli sogs// nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa mchog rnams la// gus pas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal sras bzang po skyong*// kha ba can na dpal ldan mar me mdzad// dga' ldan gnas na nam mkha' dri ma med// yid bzhin nor bu lta bur gzhan don mdzad// dpal ldan a ti sha la gsol ba 'debs// nag tsho lo tsā rnal 'byor pa chen po// yer pa zhang btsun phyag pa khri mchog dang*// dgon pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan sku mched lnga// 'gar 'gos yol sogs dpal ldan a ti shas// rjes bzung skyes mchog rnams la gsol ba 'debs// yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs kyi mgon// rgyal ba'i gdung tshab gyur pa rgyal ba'i sras// rang gzhan don gnyis 'byung gnas rin po che// bshes gnyen ston pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bskal pa du mar tshogs gnyis goms pa'i mthus// gnas gsum don la mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// a ti sha yi sras kyi thu bo pa// legs pa'i shes rab zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mar me mdzad dpal rgyal ba kun gyi yab// rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba rgya tsho las// gdams pa'i khu ba bton nas tshims mdzad pa'i// brtson 'grus g.yung drung zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// long med thugs la 'khrungs pa'i spo to ba// bdag pas gzhan gces sgom pa'i spyan snga ba// sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa'i phu chung ba// (608)rgyal sras sku mched gsum la gsol ba 'debs// sne'u zur ye shes 'bar dang 'ben gung rgyal// kha rag sgom chung ka ma shes rab 'od// dgyer sgom khu dbon byang chub dge mdzes kyi// slob brgyud gdan rab rnams la gsol 'debs// glang ri thang pa sha ra yon tan grags// dol pa sher rgyam 'byung gnas rdo rje dang*// lce sgom rdzong pa sha pho sgang pa yi// slob brgyud gdan rabs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'chad kha ye rdor se spyil chos rgyal mtshan// lung gi dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon po sogs// lha yi mtshan can rim par byon pa yi// slob brgyud gdan rabs rnams la=

/gtum ston blo gros grags pa shes rab grags// rdo rje 'od dang gro ston bdud rtsi grags// zhang ston sangs rgyas sgom pa mchims chen po'i// slob brgyud gdan rabs rnams la= /stod lung rin chen snying po smyug rum pa// bya yul ba dang nang gi thugs sras gsum// phyi yi che dgu bar gyi che brgyad sogs// slob brgyud gdan rabs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// gnyos pa bra gong zangs chen dar bsod pa// mtsho sna sher bzang mon grwa tshul khrims mtshan// ri steng rgyal bzang chos rje rin chen sogs// gdan rabs rim byon rnams la gsol ba 'debs// blo ldan shes rab tshe spang chos bla ma// blo gros 'byung gnas khyung po rin chen grags// shes rab 'bar dang seng chen brgyad la sogs// gdan rabs rim byon rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal sras spyod mchog phyag len tshul bzhin du// mdzad la mtshungs bral thogs med bzang po dpal// lo chen byang rtse 'gro mgon dpal ye ba// gzhon nu rgyal mchog rnams la= /dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs// dri med (609)mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam dpal dbyangs// gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha pa// blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mgon des rjes bzung bstan 'dzin skyes bu mchog /rgyal tshab mkhas grub dge 'dun grub pa sogs// lung bstan rnam dag thob pa'i thugs sras bdun// dag pa rnam brgyad srid zhu'i bu chen bdun// gdan sa'i phrin las spel ba'i mkhas grub brgyad// thugs zin rnam gsum rtsod med bu chen gsum// rtogs ldan rnam pa bzhi dang ri sgrub gnyis// gzhung lugs rab 'byams mkhyen pa'i mkhas mchog zung*// stod smad sher bzang rnam gnyis byang sems gnyis// grags pa rnam gnyis sems dpa' rnam gnyis dang*// bka' babs 'dzin pa'i bu chen rnam pa drug /sde dpon grub thob gsum dang rigs btsun gsum// bstan 'dzin bu gsum thugs grol mkhan po gcig

/sbas pa'i grub thob mkhas mchog chos rje gnyis// rgod phrug ras pa gung du rgyal bzang sogs// lung rtogs phrin las phyogs mthar spel mdzad pa// rang rkya thon pa brgya dang bzhi bcu yi// slob brgyud gdan rabs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'gran zla bral ba'i skyabs gnas khyed rnams kyis// gsol ba 'debs la thugs rje brtse bas gzigs// 'di nas tshe rabs kun tu rjes bzung ste// rnam thar yongs rdzogs 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur drin can rje// tshul bzhin bsten pa lam gyi rtsa ba ru// legs par mthong nas 'bad ba du ma yi// gus pa chen pos bsten par byin gyis rlobs// lan gcig rnyed pa'i dal ba'i rten bzang 'di// shin tu rnyed dka' don che shes gyur nas// nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa'i blo// rgyun chad med par skye bar byin gyis rlobs// (610)lus srog g.yo ba chu yi chu bur bzhin// myur du 'jig pa'i 'chi ba dran pa dang*// shi ba'i rjes su lus dang grib ma bzhin// dkar nag las 'bras phyi bzhin 'brang ba la// nges pa brtan po rnyed nas nyes pa'i tshogs// phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang spong ba dang*// dge tshogs mtha' dag sgrub par byed pa la// rtag tu bag dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas mi ngoms sdug bsngal kun gyi sgo// yid brtan mi rung srid pa'i phun tshogs kyi// nyes dmigs rig nas thar pa'i bde ba la// don gnyer chen po skye bar byin gyis rlobs// rnam dag bsam pa de yis drangs pa yi// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod chen po yis// bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa la// sgrub pa snying por byed par= /rang nyid srid mtshor lhung ba ji bzhin du// mar gyur 'gro ba kun kyang de 'dra bar// mthong nas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i khur khyer ba'i// byang chub sems mchog 'byongs par= /sems tsam bskyed kyang tshul khrims rnam gsum la// goms pa med na byang chub mi 'grub pa// legs par mthong nas rgyal sras sdom pa la// brtson pa drag pos slob par=

/log pa'i yul la g.yeng ba zhi byed cing*// yang dag don la tshul bzhin dpyad pa yi// zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i lam// myur du rgyud la skye bar= /thun mong lam sbyangs snod du gyur pa na// theg pa kun gyi mchog gyur rdo rje'i theg /skal bzang skye bo'i 'jug ngogs dam pa der// bde blag nyid du 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// de tshe dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub pa'i gzhi// rnam dag dam tshig sdom par gsungs pa la// bcos ma min pa'i nges pa rnyed gyur nas// srog dang bsdos te bsrung bar= /de nas rgyud sde'i snying po rim gnyis kyi// gnad rnams ji bzhin rtogs nas brtson pa yis// thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor (611)spyod las mi g.yel bar// dam pa'i gsung bzhin sgrub par byin gyis rlobs// de ltar lam bzang ston pa'i bshes gnyen dang*// tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i grogs rnams zhabs brtan cing*// phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa'i tshogs// nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces brjod/ bye brag lam rim dang blo sbyong brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bka' gdams rnying ma las brgyud pa jo nang rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa dang gsar ma brgyud pa dang byin rlabs nye brgyud kyi gsol 'debs rje rin po che'i gsung sogs ji ltar nus pas gsol ba btabs/ slar/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi nyon mongs pa mtha' dag zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos thos bsam sgom gsum nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

tshul khrims rnam par dag pa spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la dad gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa bdag gi rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dad gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byang chub kyi sems nyams pa med pa bdag gi rgyud la skye ba gnas pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bstan pa'i chos mtha' dag bdag gi rgyud la skye ba gnas pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa bdag gi rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid (612)rig pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa bdag gi rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags mtha' dag gi snod du rung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mngon par shes pa rgya chen po thob par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol// sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// thob nas kyang sems can nam mkha' dang mnyam pa smin par byed nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa'i gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ 'dir dge bshes snar thang ba mchims chen po'i zhal nas/ rang nyid bla ma'i bka' bcag pa la sogs pa dam tshig nyams pa'i dogs pa mchis na bar skabs 'dir snod rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa gcig bla ma sku gsum 'dus pa'i mdun du bsam/ de'i nang du bdag nyid dkar mer gyi zhu bar bsam la de la bla ma'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gsol bas zho ldag pa bzhin du bsam/ des dgyes par yang bsam ste de ltar yang dang yang du bya'o gsungs/ de nas slar yang*/ bdag sogs nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro'i tshogs kyis// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul// sdig pa bshags shing dge la rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor bskul zhing mya ngan mi 'dar gsol// dus gsum dge ba dgongs pa rdzogs phyir bsngo/

/zhes yan lag bdun pa bsdus pa sgom dan dang bcas pa tshar gcig phul nas/ bdag blo gti mug rmongs pa'i dbang gyur te// legs spyad 'di la nyes par gyur pa gang*// skyes mchog rin chen rnams dang de yi sras// bdag nyid chen po rnams la bzod par gsol/ /zhes cho ga lhag chad du gyur ba dang bas brgyud ma dag bas byas pa la sogs pa'i nongs pa bshags te/ 'gro drug sems can mtha' med 'phyan rnams la// re sa gzhan na med pas thugs rjes gzigs// bdag sogs skye ba 'di nas byang chub bar// rje btsun khyed dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba 'dzin par shog /ces 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab nas/ lha tshogs thams (613)cad chu la chu sbur ltar// mtshungs med bla ma nyid du dbyer med gyur// de yang bde chen bdud rtsir rab zhu ba// tshangs bug nas zhugs bdag gi sgo gsum gyi// sgrib pa sa bon myong 'gyur bcas pa dag /dbang bzhi thob cing lhan skyes ye shes mchog /mngon byas rang yang dpal ldan bla ma ltar// 'brel tshad don ldan 'gro mgon chen por gyur/

/ces tshogs rten bsdu zhing*/ chos rnams thams cad snang stong chu zla ltar// spros med phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin bla// snang grags dpal ldan bla ma'i rol pa che// dag pa rab 'byams nyid du grol bar gyur/ /ces pa'i don stong pa nyid wal pa gcig sgom pa dang mnyam rjes bsre ba'i zhing sbyong gi dmigs pa yang dran par byas nas dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ste/ 'dis mtshon bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs// thams cad bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas rnam thar phrin las dang*// smon lam ma lus bdag gis 'grub phyir bsngo// 'chi tshe gnad gcod sdug bsngal mi 'byung bar// byams chen thugs rje'i 'od kyis myur drangs te// ma pham mgon po sras bcas bzhugs pa'i zhing*// rnam dag dga' ldan gnas su skye bar shog /rgyal tshab rje dang thugs sras mchog rnams las// zab rgyas chos thos mi ldog lung bstan thob// byang chub spyod pa rgya mtsho mthar sbyin nas// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog /dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa gnyis sku thob par shog /byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig/ skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// byang chub (614)spyod la gzhol ba dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing*// bdud kyi las rnams spong bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni// 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa// sems can rnams pa de 'byor shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog /ces brjod/

de nas/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ sogs bzang spyod tshang ba dang*/ byams smon sogs theg pa chen po'i bsngo smon rgyas par byas nas mjug tu yig brgya lan kha shas brjod pa phyag len tu snang ngo*// de ltar rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dkon mchog rin po che rnams la rang nyid ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pas mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ chos spyod yan lag bdun la brtson pa ni bstan pa rin po che dang mjal ba rnams kyis bya rgyu'i snying po yin pas 'dir yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen shar ba chen po'i gsung sgros bla ma'i 'das mchod rjes dran drug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas sgom pa'i tshogs chos yan lag bdun pa rnams kyi dgongs pa bzhin bkod pa'o/ /dad blos brtsams pa'i rnam dkar sa bon gyis// 'gro kun mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis// rjes bzung byang chub spyod pa'i myu gu smin// rnam mkhyen 'bras bzang brdal ba'i rgyur gyur cig /tshe 'di blos btang lta spyod dri med pas// gzhan don sangs rgyas sgrub mdzad bka' gdams pa'i// rnam thar gtsang ma bde blag 'grub nas kyang*// nam mkha' dri ma med dang mnyam nyid shog /dge bcu'i gtams pa'i nor 'dzin gtsang ma ru// chos spyod rnam bcu'i sman ljongs rab brdal bas// yid can mtha' dag gtan bde'i ngal 'tsho thob// bkra shis dpal gyi sa gsum kun khyab shog /ces gdams ngag (615) rin po che'i mdzod du bka' gdams chos skor zhabs 'degs su nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te// ris med rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin la gus pa thob pa ku sā li blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spungs yang khrod tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ/ (616)
